papers.title_en: Bayesian Partner Modelling enables Adaptive Replanning for LLM Coordination
papers.authors: Harsh Goel, Aditya Sai Ellendula, Vaishnav Tadiparthi, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Sandeep P. Chinchali
papers.evidence: 基于贝叶斯伙伴建模的LLM协作自适应重规划
papers.tldr: 多智能体LLM系统面对中途改变策略的新队友时，常因执行长时程技能而沿用过时计划。现有方法要么被动跟踪、反应迟缓，要么盲目重规划。本文提出BayesBeliefAgent，将分层LLM规划器与贝叶斯跟踪模块结合，仅当队友行为与推断技能直接矛盾时才中断当前技能。在Overcooked基准上，矛盾条件控制大幅缩小信念-动作差距，且重规划次数比启发式方法少一个数量级。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems often struggle to collaborate with new teammates whose strategies shift mid-task. Because agents execute multi-step or temporally extended skills, they frequently continue executing outdated plans long after public evidence shows that a partner has changed its skill. Existing methods either treat partner tracking as passive context-leaving the agent aware of the shift but slow to act-or replan indiscriminately. We introduce BayesBeliefAgent, which pairs a hierarchical LLM planner with a Bayesian tracking module. Rather than replanning constantly, our agent interrupts its current skill only when a partner's actions directly contradict the inferred skill. Beyond standard reward, we evaluate performance using replanning efficiency and the belief-action gap: the fraction of total decisions where an agent with a correct partner estimate executes a non-complementary skill. Across benchmark Overcooked environments, contradiction-conditioned control drastically narrows this belief-action gap while requiring an order of magnitude fewer replans than heuristic methods

papers.title_en: Beyond the Transcript: Detecting Covert Co ordination in Latent Multi-Agent Communication
papers.authors: Ramneet Kaur, Pradyumna Chari, Ramesh Raskar, Jugad Singh, Sumit Kumar Jha, Anirban Roy
papers.evidence: 检测潜在多智能体通信中的隐蔽协调
papers.tldr: 语言模型代理可通过连续隐藏状态进行公共文本之外的隐秘通信，构成潜在勾结风险。本文提出VLA框架，利用共享事件标识将潜在状态与公开行为关联，采用异常检测、反事实影响与稀疏自编码器三层监控，并支持黑盒与白盒引导。在拍卖基准上对同构/异构代理监控AUROC达0.993/0.854，白盒引导完全恢复出价分布并大幅减少勾结行为。该研究为监控潜在通信提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents can communicate through continuous hidden states that are invisible in public transcripts, creating opportunities for covert harmful coordination. We introduce Verifiable Latent Alignments (VLA), an activation-aware framework for monitoring and steering these private communication channels. For every monitored decision, VLA links the private latent-state record and channel status to the resulting public action using a shared event identifier, enabling matched causal analysis. Our first contribution is a neutral-only three-layer monitor combining representation anomaly detection, counterfactual action-distribution influence, and sparse-autoencoder interpretation support. Our second contribution is a steerability framework spanning black-box behavioral instructions and white-box matched-neutral counterfactuals. Our third contribution is an evaluation on a controlled multi-agent auction benchmark covering homogeneous and heterogeneous model pairs, many-agent scalability, and intervention effectiveness. The sequential monitor achieves mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.993 for homogeneous agents and 0.854 for heterogeneous pairs when text- and latent-collusion rows are pooled as positives. In Qwen3-0.6B auctions with 25-100 bidders, monitoring requires only a small normalized load relative to all possible directed pairs, while full white-box steering achieves 100% bid-distribution recovery and reduces collusive low-bid behavior by 47.3 percentage points. Because full white-box steering replays the matched neutral counterfactual, its exact recovery is a sanity check by construction. Overall, the controlled study shows that the evaluated private channel attacks can be monitored without training the primary monitor on attack examples and mitigated when matched counterfactual access is available.

papers.title_en: Deciding Relabeling Observation Consistency in Multi-Agent Discrete-Event Systems
papers.evidence: 多智能体离散事件系统中的交互动态与观测一致性
papers.tldr: 多智能体离散事件系统使用共同模板控制同构智能体，部分观测下最大许可监督器要求重标号观测一致性（ROC），其可判定性此前开放。本文证明ROC判定是PSPACE完全的，覆盖非确定性工厂（两个可观测、一个不可观测事件）与确定性工厂（两个可观测、两个不可观测事件）。在易处理方面，刻画了保证所有工厂满足ROC的重标号，给出不可观测事件上单射时的多项式时间算法，并基于饱和与模拟提出可多项式检验的充分条件。进一步证明ROC对成对不相交模板具有组合性，并纠正了文献中不正确的结构条件。
papers.abstract_en: Scalable supervisors for multi-agent discrete-event systems control groups of isomorphic agents through a common template. Under partial observation, such a supervisor is maximally permissive if the relabeling that maps the agents onto their template is relabeling observation consistent (ROC) and a local companion condition holds. Whether ROC is decidable was open. We show that it is PSPACE-complete: for nondeterministic plants with two observable and one unobservable event, and for deterministic plants with two observable and two unobservable events. On the tractable side, we characterize the relabelings that guarantee ROC for every plant, we give a polynomial-time algorithm for deterministic plants whose relabeling is injective on unobservable events, and we give sufficient conditions based on saturation and on simulation, with polynomial-time tests for both. We further show that ROC is compositional for components with pairwise disjoint templates, with equivalence if the alphabets are moreover pairwise disjoint, and that neither hypothesis can be dropped. Finally, we show that the structural condition proposed in the literature to guarantee ROC is incorrect, and repair the companion inclusion that the same proposition asserts.

papers.title_en: TileMix: Tile-Centric Mixed-Precision Attention for LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.authors: Hanzhi Zhang, Qiao Zhang, Qinglei Cao, Heng Fan, Yan Huang, Kewei Sha, Yunhe Feng
papers.evidence: 以分片为中心的混合精度注意力路由内核，用于可扩展注意力
papers.tldr: 长上下文预填充中，密集自注意力的计算与内存开销巨大。现有加速方法要么使用统一低精度，要么稀疏化token交互，缺乏在融合注意力中对硬件对齐分数块进行空间精度路由。TileMix提出以tile为中心的混合精度路由内核，把注意力矩阵划分为硬件对齐的score tiles，用位掩码路由每个tile组走FP16或INT8计算，同时共享在线softmax状态。在LongEval、LV-Eval等基准上，TileMix恢复了统一INT8损失的长上下文质量，并相对FP16提升预填充吞吐，给出了跨模型族的可控精度-效率前沿。无需训练，支持GQA与可变长度批次，为LLM推理加速提供了新的空间精度决策机制。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context prefill in large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory traffic because dense self-attention computes quadratic query-key scores. Existing methods either use a uniform low-precision path or select token interactions, leaving spatial precision routing over hardware-aligned score tiles outside fused dense attention. We introduce TileMix, a tile-centric precision-routing kernel that makes numerical precision an executable spatial decision over score-tile groups within fused dense attention. TileMix partitions the attention matrix into hardware-aligned score tiles, packs routing decisions into compact bitmasks, and dispatches each tile group through FP16 or INT8 score computation while both paths update a shared online-softmax state. Scalable precision grouping lets each routing bit govern multiple adjacent key tiles, preserving hardware-aligned compute tiles and compact metadata at long contexts. By routing all legal tile groups, TileMix preserves dense token connectivity, requires no training, and supports grouped-query attention, variable-length batches, and INT8 key/value caches. Across LongEval, LV-Eval, and A100 prefill benchmarks on LLaMA, Qwen, and Vicuna, TileMix recovers long-context quality lost under uniform INT8 and improves prefill throughput over FP16, yielding a controllable accuracy-efficiency frontier across model families. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TileMix.

papers.title_en: Adversarial Review: Structured Disagreement for Grounded Agentic Code Review
papers.evidence: 多智能体协作与结构化分歧
papers.tldr: 多智能体代码审查常因智能体数量增加而收益递减，而纯子智能体又丧失交互优势。本文提出对抗性审查（AR）协议，由主编码智能体、审查者和批评者组成最小协作，批评者通过结构化分歧审计审查意见。在LiveCodeBench取得最高通过率，仅用三智能体即超过五智能体基线；在SWE-PRBench上加显式分歧后F1最优，并在SWE-bench Verified上亦有提升。研究表明，有效协作审查的关键在于最小、结构化且基于证据的分歧，而非增加智能体或通信复杂度。
papers.abstract_en: Early multi-agent LLM systems often used role-separated teams, yet scaling agent count yields diminishing returns on repository-level coding tasks. Recent alternatives treat agents as passive tools (subagents), yet this removes the benefits of agent interaction entirely. We study whether a subagent paradigm can support a middle ground: minimal agentic cooperation without the overhead of large multi-agent teams. We introduce Adversarial Review (AR), a minimal cooperative code-review protocol in which a main coding agent works with a reviewer and a critic agent. The reviewer evaluates code, while the critic audits the review through structured disagreement before the main agent edits. On LiveCodeBench, AR achieves the highest pass rate among tested methods, outperforming a five-agent baseline while using only three agents. On SWE-PRBench, naive AR exposes a false-consensus failure mode, where agents converge on agreement without sufficient evidence, but a single prompt iteration that adds disagreement explicitly achieves the highest F1 among tested methods. On SWE-bench Verified, AR also shows improvements over the baselines on repository-level coding tasks. Together, AR demonstrates that cooperative code review does not require many agents or complex communication structures: it requires that disagreement be minimal, structured, and evidence-grounded.

papers.title_en: A Multi-Agent Platform for Automated Enterprise Analytics and Insight Generation
papers.authors: Manoj N M, Vijayakrishna S, Manjunath Srinivas, Rohit Pahan
papers.evidence: 面向对话式商业智能的多智能体流水线
papers.tldr: 企业数据分析面临自然语言查询到可视化洞察的转化难题。本文提出基于CrewAI的多智能体平台，五个专用智能体顺序处理查询、检索分析数据、经MCP生成可视化并输出建议，结合深度防御安全架构和查询参数化。在300个测试用例上实现95.3%功能准确率、24秒平均延迟、4.52/5质量分，较单智能体准确率提升22.6个百分点、质量提升20.2%，消融实验证明核心智能体作用显著。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a multi-agent framework built on CrewAI [1] for conversational business intelligence. Five specialized AI agents operate in a sequential pipeline to process natural language queries, retrieve and analyze data, generate visualizations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [2], and deliver actionable insights. The platform features a defense-in-depth security architecture for multi-tenant data isolation and a query parameterization mechanism for transforming conversational insights into reusable dashboard components. Evaluation across 300 end-to-end test cases spanning synthetic and production enterprise datasets demonstrates 95.3% functional accuracy, a mean response latency of 24 seconds, and a response quality score of 4.52/5.0 as assessed by an LLM-as-a-Judge framework, with a 93.0% hallucination-free rate, representing a 22.6 percentage point accuracy improvement and 20.2% quality gain over a single-agent baseline. Cross-model evaluation across four LLM backends and human expert validation confirm architectural generalizability and evaluator reliability. An ablation study confirms that the Data Analysis and Report Aggregation agents are the primary drivers of output quality.
